(+)-Sabinene synthase
(EC 4.2.3.110,
SS
) is an
enzyme
with
systematic name
geranyl-diphosphate diphosphate-lyase [cyclizing, (+)-sabinene-forming]
.
[
1
]
[
2
]
This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
geranyl diphosphate
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
(+)-
sabinene
+
diphosphate
This enzyme is isolated from
Salvia officinalis
(sage).
